name: chat-app
description: PingWise is a modern real-time chat application built with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB. It enables seamless one-to-one conversations with support for text and image sharing, profile management, and real-time updates via Socket.IO. Designed with a clean UI and responsive design, PingWise provides an intuitive and engaging chat experience.

scripts.build: npm run install-backend && npm run install-frontend && npm run build-frontend
